description: Clearly-stated durable preferences and identity facts. Failing to capture these is the failure mode; this is the positive control.

turns.input: I'm the platform lead here, and I prefer concise answers without preamble.
Always use TypeScript examples rather than JavaScript when you show code.
And we deploy on Cloudflare Workers, so keep examples runtime-appropriate.
What's the best way to cache a computed value per request?
turns.reply: Store it on the request context so it lives exactly as long as the request.
